purpose: zero-training diagnostic of whether two legal public commitment plans have a stable, paired value difference in the standard P8 interface

plans.maintain_primary: All agents retain PRIMARY_SERVICE during the public commitment window; after the request becomes public, all switch to FUTURE_SERVICE.
plans.stage_forecast: Scout and relay take FORECAST_STAGE while executor retains PRIMARY_SERVICE during the public commitment window; after the request becomes public, all switch to FUTURE_SERVICE.

paired_randomization.pairing: Each plan pair is reset with exactly the same seed and reliability; realized future variables are checked equal after rollout.

interpretation: This audit establishes only a simulator-level paired plan-value signal and its variability. It does not train a policy, demonstrate that PPO can learn the signal, establish a causal policy mechanism, or constitute paper evidence.
